info.title: Bridge Interactive Platform Universal API
info.description: Access Bridge Interactive listing data through the Bridge Web API and RESO Web API. This app covers the officially documented read surfaces for listings, agents, offices, open houses, members, properties, and lookup metadata.

get.description: Retrieves an agent from Bridge Interactive Platform.
